what: Pressing on the board leaves a fingertip mark (clay oval with concentric grain, width 14u·u = window width/1400) is stamped, and dragging while pressed rubs clay with horizontal grain in the direction of travel every 10u moved. Over 700u of dragging the clay runs out, getting paler and thinner (.75~1x). On stamping it appears in .12s, settles from 1.04x in .16s, and after release stays 3.5s, then fades over 5.5s with smoothstep, blurring up to 4px until it disappears. Marks stick to the document and move with scroll. The color is --kf-accent, blended with multiply

options.hold: Time to stay put after letting go (seconds), default 3.5
options.reach: Distance in one drag before the clay runs out (u, in window width/1400 units), default 700
options.blur: Max blur radius when disappearing (px), default 4

note: Not stamped over links, buttons, or input fields, data-fx-part="skip" child is skipped too. Text selection is blocked on the panel (dragging is this part’s job). On touch only presses are stamped, and dragging scrolls the page as usual (touchmove is not blocked). The function that makes clay pieces is window.kfClay.stamp(rx, ry, color, dpr, "lines"|"loop") offered out so that the side writing letters in clay, like the loader, uses the same texture

from.where: All pages — in the original, a canvas where clay is smeared by pressing and dragging (brown 122,84,58, multiply), fading at 5.5s after 3.5s of a 9s lifetime
